summary: @servicetitan/line-item-editor preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package's npm preinstall script (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js on every install. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle marked "// @bun @bun-cjs" with obfuscator.io-style string-array indirection (rotator function WV8StW and a >700-entry numeric symbol-table array), so its behavior cannot be reviewed from source. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-named locals (_0x488df8, _0x52943e) and property-name-mapping objects hiding strings such as "--version", "/etc/os-release", and "musl", concealing its own control flow. The package is advertised as a React line-item TreeList editor UI component, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or a compiled binary bundle at install time. The alternate-runtime execution bypasses Node-based install-time scanners and runs attacker-authored code with the user's privileges on every npm install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
